# dsh-wallpaper
简体中文 · **English**
A wallpaper plugin for **DeepSeek Harness** — put a photo behind the whole GUI.
DeepSeek Harness ships three appearance modes (light / dark / follow system), and its theme tokens o
nly carry colours — there is no wallpaper feature and no custom-CSS box. This plugin adds one: a rea
l image behind the sidebar, the conversation and the composer, with the surfaces turned into translu
cent glass so the photo shows through.
## What it does

- **Host half** (`lib/index.js`) registers a small API on the DSH web server:
- `GET /dsh-wallpaper/

config.json` — the settings file, plus the image's mtime;
- `GET /dsh-wallpaper/image` — the image i

tself (jpg / jpeg / png / webp / avif / gif / svg);
- `POST /dsh-wallpaper/config` — merge a patch i

nto the settings (clamped to sane ranges);
- `POST /dsh-wallpaper/upload` — store an uploaded photo

(magic-byte check, 40 MB cap) and point the config at it.
- **Client half** (`lib/client.js`) inject
s one `<style>` element and paints the photo on `<html>` as a fixed background, then overrides five

surface tokens with translucent versions of a neutral palette:
`--dsw-alias-bg-base`, `--dsw-alias-b

g-layer-1`, `--dsw-alias-bg-layer-2`, `--dsw-alias-bg-layer-3`, `--dsw-alias-bg-module-platform`.
It
also registers a **设置 → 背景壁纸** page, so the whole thing is driven from the GUI.
Overlays, masks and modals (`--dsw-alias-bg-overlay`, `--dsw-alias-bg-mask-*`) are deliberately left
alone so dialogs stay readable.
Everything is wrapped in `try/catch`: a client entry that throws aborts the whole web boot and makes
the desktop disable every third-party plugin, so this one must never throw.
## Install
Requires a DSH build with client-plugin support (the desktop app or `dsh web`), and a plugin profile
— `desktop` by default.
Recommended: paste the prebuilt tarball URL into **Plugins → Add plugin**, or use the standard CLI:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Replace `desktop` if you use another profile. The package includes prebuilt client JavaScript, the b
undle patch, and the default wallpaper; no local build is required.
Manual installation follows:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Copy the package into the profile and the settings into the wallpaper folder — `$DSH_HOME/wallpaper`
, or `~/.dsh/wallpaper` when `DSH_HOME` is unset:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then append this block to `$PROFILE/cordis.patch.yml` (or run `tools/install-wallpaper.sh`, which do
es all of the above and backs the file up first):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
No restart needed: the loader hot-applies the new entry and the page picks the module up on its own.
## Use it
Open **设置 → 背景壁纸** (Settings → Wallpaper): pick a photo with **选择图片…**, turn the wallpaper on or off
, and drag the sliders. Every change is saved immediately and the running app repaints behind the pa
nel — no restart, no reload.
Drop a photo into the wallpaper folder and point `config.json` at it:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Switch to another window and back — the plugin re-reads the settings whenever the window regains foc
us, and the image is cache-busted by its modification time, so no reload is required.
| Key | Default | Meaning |

| `enabled` | `true` | `false` removes the layer and the style, i.e. temporarily off |
| `image` | `
current.jpg` | file name inside the wallpaper folder; without an extension it tries jpg → jpeg → png

→ webp → avif |
| `scrim` | `0.45` | black veil over the photo, 0–1. Raise it if text feels washed

out |
| `blur` | `0` | blur radius in px, 8–24 gives a frosted look; above 0 the photo moves to a fi

ltered layer |
| `saturation` | `1` | 0.6 for a muted look, 1.4 for punchier colours |
| `translucen
cy` | `0.5` | how much of the photo comes through the UI surfaces; 0 = almost opaque, 1 = strongest
y` | `0.5` | how much of the photo comes through the UI surfaces; 0 = almost opaque, 1 = strongest |
## Light and dark
The plugin ships two neutral palettes and switches on the theme's own `body[data-ds-dark-theme]` att
ribute, so it follows 设置 → 通用 → 外观 (light / dark / follow system) automatically. Accent colours, syn
tax highlighting, borders and text colours are untouched — only the surfaces change.
If you also run a glass theme (for example Catppuccin), the wallpaper takes over the surfaces; the t
heme keeps its accents and text palette.
## Uninstall

1. Remove the `- insert: dsh-wallpaper` block from `$PROFILE/cordis.patch.yml`.
2. Delete `$PROFILE/
node_modules/dsh-wallpaper/`.
The wallpaper folder can stay where it is; it does nothing on its own.
## Project layout
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`tools/install-wallpaper.sh` installs into a profile, `tools/toggle-wallpaper.py` unloads and reload
s the entry so a changed `lib/` is picked up without restarting the app, and `tools/test-client.mjs`
+ `tools/test-host.mjs` are dependency-free smoke tests.
